items.title: David Weinstein Interview, 1988-09-22
items.q: Wade was in the Eastern Band too. So was Godfrey Hirsch.

ctx.x: There could be some confusion there. Oh, sure. Well, no, there's just a million names.

Yes. Yes. Wade was in the Eastern Band too. So was Godfrey Hirsch. You see, as you're unconscious of these things come back to you. But Godfrey was a perennial student. Godfrey stayed at Warren Easton for six years, you know. I think he liked the atmosphere. And then he went to Tulane for about another 27. Yeah. And he played in the Tulaneans. Tell us about the Tulaneans. I don't know what you bought him. I didn't, I didn't work with that band. Godfrey played with that band. That was another, just a name to me.…
a trombone, clarinet. No. What about Schofi and Leon Prima? What kind of band was that?
